scripts.pretest: node -e "const [a,b]=process.versions.node.split('.').map(Number);if(a<22||(a===22&&b<18)){console.error('SlopMachine needs Node 22.18 or newer to run .ts tests; this is Node '+process.version+' at '+process.execPath+'. Run: nvm use (see .nvmrc) or put a newer node first on PATH.');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.zip: npm run check && node -e "console.log('Chrome Web Store package: release/slopmachine-' + require('./package.json').version + '.zip')"
scripts.detector:fetch: node scripts/detector/fetch.mjs && python3 scripts/detector/fetch_raid.py && python3 scripts/detector/fetch_modern.py
